# Actor metadata capture

This is the minimal projection of a real browser-runtime Actor metadata capture
from 12 November 2026. The identifier is redacted; runtime, runner and enabled
and creation time are retained. Update time and registration identity are omitted. No conversation,
prompt, account, credential or machine data is included.

The tests apply explicitly labelled configuration and fault mutations to this
captured Actor. These mutations are not claimed to be captured picker states,
available model entitlements, executed browser transitions or send receipts.
